reviewedRedactions.method: Local Gaussian blur, visually reviewed; region and pixel checks in legacy-media-blur.json.

webpPublication.method: Lossless local WebP encoding of already reviewed/blurred assets; visible decoded RGBA pixels, frame counts, delays and loop counts verified unchanged. Hidden RGB under zero alpha is canonicalized only for comparison and changes are counted separately. This is a publication transform, not a new capture or benchmark run.

redaction: Installer captures use local 12px blur, including low-effects mode and visible tooltips. Legacy images and native Android game media have local Gaussian blur baked into published pixels; separate records bind source/output hashes, regions and pixel checks. Native GIFs are blurred before resizing and palette encoding. Unblurred captures and OCR text are excluded from published assets.
limits: OCR and pattern checks can miss account names, QR codes, private hosts or illegible text. This report does not certify every asset as free of sensitive information; new or changed media requires another review.

nativeGameMedia.method: Local Pillow Gaussian blur before PNG publication and before GIF resizing/palette encoding
